`data.endsInLabel != null || isSkeleton ? … : …` picks between two DIFFERENT elements — that is a resting shape written by hand at the call site, and it drifts from the real one the first time the real one changes. Give the component below an `isSkeleton` prop and pass the flag down; let it rest as ITSELF. A ternary is fine when both arms are the same component.
